gen-eater-gf-lexend-tera: Lexend Tera draws every curve with one plotter-pen line, spaced out like stepping stones. Eater turns dark and aggressive above it, its thin strokes only slightly lighter than its stems.
gen-flavors-gf-lexend-zetta: Lexend Zetta lays down constant-width strokes, tall in the lowercase and widely tracked. Flavors up top is whimsical and commanding, so paragraphs below it would move at an unhurried, approachable pace, every word given room.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-cascadia-mono: Expressive and distinctive, Tektur bends pipe-cleaner strokes into oversized lowercase with generous terminal openings. Cascadia Mono, a plain sans, stands its letters like pins in a wide board, compact and modern beneath it.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-montserr: Montserrat Alternates reads smoothly, its c gaping like a bent paperclip and its round letters rimmed to match the stems. Love Ya Like A Sister brings the swagger; long paragraphs below keep moving.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-lexend-giga: Big sidebearings, soft nib strokes: Metamorphous sets the tone, over Lexend Giga, a plain sans of single-width lines and generous tracking. Metamorphous does the commanding, while Lexend Giga does the opening-up of each word.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-lexend-peta: In Oxanium, a high x-height makes lowercase look huge, while Lexend Peta, a plain sans, matches with its own big x-height. What links them is curves that never thin out.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-lexend-tera: Paprika commands attention, its lowercase filling the line like capitals and its letters scattered wide. Lexend Tera does the steady reading, a sans with a single plotter-pen weight throughout.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-lexend-zetta: Expressive from the start, Revalia stretches a tall band of letters with short stalks above. And Lexend Zetta, sans-serif with no stroke contrast, would carry paragraph after paragraph at a spacious, unhurried pace.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-montserrat-alter: Montserrat Alternates reads steadily, stroke widths staying put from stem to curve and lowercase crowding toward the capital line. Snowburst One, stencil-cut with wide bridges, shouts above it, so paragraphs below would flow smoothly.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-cascadia-code: Commanding in its tube-like, constant-width stroke, Tilt Neon splays its c terminal and stands tall in the lowercase. Statements belong to the heading; Cascadia Code, sans-serif, handles the wire-thin detail.
